name: Meng Hui Nanchao
source: As the royal princess of the Southern Dynasty, you are faced with the biggest turmoil of your homeland. With the loyal support of Kirin and Lancelot, you will set out an adventurous expedition to defeat the enemies and restore peace within your homeland. Along the journey you will become acquainted with many other charming male characters who will devote to you their selfless and unconditional love.
